series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: Bill Williams Market Facilitation Index MFI=(High−Low)/Volume with tick-volume proxy in forex. Four color states from joint ΔMFI and ΔVolume: green (both up)=efficient trend participation; brown (both down)=squat/indecision; blue (MFI up, volume down)=fake/range expansion without participation; pink (MFI down, volume up)=fade/exhaustion. Absolute MFI is discarded; adjacent-bar relative color is the regime feature, paired with MA for direction.
data_needed: High, Low, tick or real Volume; MFI histogram; Volume(ind) vs Volume(ind+1); optional MA(8)
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY M12 year 2023 optimization; forex tick-volume; equities prefer real volume
why_new_for_mis: Four-state volume-efficiency quadrant is a compact liquidity×range regime sensor that does not rely on zero-line oscillators.
quote: The Market Facilitation Index (MFI) reflects the market's ability to make price changes within a set timeframe… it seeks to answer the question if trade volume was x amount by how much will price respond vs if it was y amount.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: Brown MFI (falling MFI and falling volume) marks volume compression and buyer/seller balance—the market “squats” before a breakout. Pattern-3 fires when brown coincides with Close crossing MA; Pattern-7 pairs brown with RSI crossing 30/70. Treated as a transition zone / coiling regime that forecasts imminent volatility expansion without forecasting direction alone.
data_needed: MFI color==brown; Close vs MA; optional RSI(30/70) crosses
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY M12 2023; Bill Williams MFI patterns 3 and 7
why_new_for_mis: Explicit squat/compression→imminent-vol sensor from MFI+volume joint decline, usable as a breakout-watch regime flag.
quote: The squat pattern typically precedes a significant movement in price, as the market is usually transitioning from consolidation to a new trend… these brown MFI regions could be thought of as transition zones.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: TRIX (triple EMA % change) crossing 0 with WPR exiting −80 (support) or −20 (resistance) marks momentum-confirmed trend flips. Pattern-0: TRX crosses above 0 and WPR rises through −80 for buys; mirror for sells. Period 3 used for sensitivity; mid −50 used in other patterns as neutral-zone gate.
data_needed: CiTriX Main; CiWPR Main; High/Low for divergence patterns; period=__PERIOD 3
why_new_for_mis: Joint TRIX zero-line acceleration with WPR S/R exit is a dual-oscillator change event for trend flip sensing.
quote: When TRIX crosses above its zero line, it marks a turn to bullish trend… Simultaneously, once the WPR moves above -80 from below, it indicates price exiting an over sold condition or bouncing off support.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: Parabolic SAR polarity flip (price crosses SAR: prior high≤SAR then low≥SAR for bullish flip) confirmed by RVI crossing zero (or RVI_UP/RVI_DN helpers). Pattern-0 couples SAR flip with RVI zero cross; Pattern-5 adds STD_DEV≥|SAR−SAR[__PERIOD]| volatility gate so flips only fire when SAR travel implies enough volatility.
data_needed: SAR values; High/Low vs SAR; RVI and signal-line helpers; STD_DEV
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPCHF H4; optimize 2023, forward into 2025 window
why_new_for_mis: SAR structural flip plus RVI momentum zero-cross, optionally volatility-gated by SAR travel vs STD_DEV, is a clean trend-reversal change sensor.
quote: Our first pattern spots potential reversals by using the parabolic SAR cross and the RVI zero line cross. The former indicator often suggests price trend change, while the latter serves as a confirmation of momentum’s direction.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: DeepSpectralMixtureLayer learns frequencies μ, variances v, weights w and emits features w·exp(−v·x²)·cos(2πμx) into a deep regressor head; ONNX-exported networks (74_0/1/5.onnx) take a 2-dim boolean vector (bullish/bearish pattern bits from Ichimoku+ADX-Wilder) and act as an extra supervised filter on raw wizard signals that previously failed forward walks.
data_needed: Ichimoku Tenkan/Kijun/Senkou A/B, Chikou; ADX/+DI/−DI; 2-col feature vectors; PyTorch SMK→ONNX
why_new_for_mis: Spectral-mixture kernel as a learned periodic feature extractor over classical S/R+trend bits is a reusable neural sensor layer for MIS sequence filtering.
quote: Our approach in this is to reconstruct the signals of each of these patterns as a simple input vector into a neural network, essentially making the neural network an extra filter to the signal.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: ADX-Wilder ≥25 (or ≥20 for Tenkan/Kijun crosses) gates Ichimoku pattern features as strong-trend regime; Senkou A/B cloud (Kumo) thickness is noted as a volatility proxy—thicker cloud ⇒ stronger S/R. Feature-0: Close crossing Senkou Span A with ADX≥25; Feature-1: Tenkan/Kijun cross with ADX≥20.
data_needed: ADX, +DI, −DI period 14; Senkou Span A/B; Close
why_new_for_mis: Pairs ADX trend-strength threshold with Ichimoku cloud thickness as a joint trend/volatility regime gate for S/R break sensors.
quote: ADX provides trend strength values in the 0 to 100 range, with anything above 25 often taken to signify a strong trend… the cloud thickness, the distance between Senkou A and B, can be a proxy for volatility.

mechanism: Triple-barrier labeling: for each event t_i,0 track path until first touch of profit-take, stop-loss, or vertical time/bar barrier. Horizontal barriers scaled by get_daily_vol (EWM std of ~1-day returns, lookback=100) via pt_sl multiples so targets adapt to prevailing volatility. Labels encode path risk outcomes {−1,0,1} or meta {0,1}, not fixed-horizon sign.
data_needed: close series; t_events; daily_vol target; vertical barriers (num_bars or timedelta); pt_sl
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M5 2018–2021 train/val, 2022–2024 OOS; Bollinger primary
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-scaled path barriers turn labeling into a risk-aware outcome sensor aligned with live stop/target geometry.
quote: in practice we want to set profit taking and stop-loss limits that are a function of the risks involved in a bet. Otherwise, sometimes we will be aiming too high (𝜏 ≫ 𝜎ti,0), and sometimes too low (𝜏 ≪ 𝜎ti,0), considering the prevailing volatility.

mechanism: Symmetric CUSUM on log returns: S+=max(0,S++ΔlogP), S−=min(0,S−+ΔlogP); fire event and reset when |S| exceeds threshold h (fixed or dynamic Series, e.g. mean daily vol). Samples bars only at significant mean-shift deviations, avoiding Bollinger-style chatter around a level—event-driven sensing of regime/activity bursts for downstream labeling.
data_needed: price or volatility series; threshold float or Series; optional filter on strategy signals
why_new_for_mis: CUSUM as a reusable significant-deviation event sampler is a change/activity sensor for MIS event clocks.
quote: We sample a bar t if and only if S_t >= threshold, at which point S_t is reset to 0… multiple events are not triggered by raw_time_series hovering around a threshold level, which is a flaw suffered by popular market signals such as Bollinger Bands.

mechanism: For triple-barrier events, count concurrent open labels per bar (num_concurrent_events), then average uniqueness ū_i = mean(1/c_t) over bars in [t_in,t_out]. Heavily overlapping labels get low weight; independent spans get ~1.0. Sample weights (and optional return-attribution / time-decay on cumulative uniqueness) correct IID violations so models sense true event frequency rather than redundant copies.
data_needed: events['t1']; close index; mp_pandas_obj concurrency and uniqueness pipelines
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M5 2018–2022; meta-labeled Bollinger and MA20/50; PurgedKFold
why_new_for_mis: Concurrency/uniqueness is an explicit temporal-overlap density sensor of how much independent information each label carries—useful beyond training as an activity/redundancy feature.
quote: For each bar in your data, count how many events are "active" at that time… For each event, calculate the reciprocal of concurrency (1/concurrency) at each bar during the event's lifespan, then average these values.

mechanism: Sequential bootstrap draws observations with P(i)∝ū_i given current sample: build indicator/active-indices of label spans, update concurrency online, score each candidate as mean 1/(c+1) over its bars, normalize to probabilities. Discourages temporally redundant draws so bootstrap ensembles maximize independent information vs standard ~63% IID bootstrap that collapses under concurrency.
data_needed: samples_info_sets (t0→t1); price_bars_index; flattened active indices; Numba seq_bootstrap_optimized
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: meta-labeled Bollinger mean-reversion; financial ML ensembles with high concurrency
why_new_for_mis: Draw-probability from live uniqueness is a sensing-aware resampling mechanism MIS can use whenever overlapping horizons corrupt independence.
quote: Instead of drawing observations with equal probability, it dynamically adjusts probabilities to favor observations that add unique information to the current sample.

mechanism: Kagi thickness/color polarity: Yin↔Yang flips on complex reversal (price moves ≥reversalAmount through prior local extreme), complex continuation after reversal, and rare weird cases. Yin→Yang opens long (buyers take control); Yang→Yin opens short. SL at prior local min/max; structure-defined regime change independent of fixed time bars.
data_needed: kagiData.isYin/isYang/isUptrend/isDowntrend; referencePrice; localMinimum/Maximum; reversalAmount; close on kagiTimeframe
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: JPN225 (Nikkei) backtest Jan–Dec 2024; any MT5 symbol via KagiTrader
why_new_for_mis: Kagi polarity flips are time-agnostic structure regime-change events MIS can stream as swing-control sensors.
quote: A shift from a Yin line to a Yang line shows that buyers have taken control… A reversal from Yang to Yin shows that sellers have taken control.

mechanism: Composite signals combine 2–3 simple signals (usage flags S/C/B) with logics AND, OR, or (OR) for parenthesization across three slots. SearchSignals evaluates GetSignal for each slot on every Symbol×TF cell and fires SetVisualCompositeSignal only when the Boolean tree is true—confluence/diversity sensing of simultaneous indicator conditions.
data_needed: C_SIGNAL slots and logics[]; simple SIGNAL files; GetUsedSlots; per-cell GetSignal booleans

why_new_for_mis: Explicit AND/OR/(OR) confluence over heterogeneous oscillator rules is a reusable multi-sensor fusion pattern for MIS.
quote: A composite signal is a signal consisting of two or more simple signals which are connected with each other by logical AND/OR operators.

mechanism: Secondary model labels whether a primary strategy side (e.g. Bollinger mean-reversion) is profitable under triple-barrier outcomes (bin∈{0,1}); predicted probability becomes conviction for position sizing—high p ⇒ aggressive size, low p ⇒ pass/small. Features blend vol-adjusted momentum, autocorrelation, skew/kurtosis, RSI/MACD/ADX/ATR, Yang-Zhang vol.
data_needed: primary side series; triple-barrier meta bins; feature set from features.py; RF or similar classifier
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M5; Bollinger w=20, 1.5σ stress config; barriers pt=1 sl=2 vertical=50 bars
why_new_for_mis: Meta-label probability as an explicit conviction/trust sensor separates direction from bet-quality for MIS sizing layers.
quote: Instead of predicting market direction, it asks: "When should I trust my other predictions?"… High confidence means you size the position aggressively. Low confidence means you pass or bet small.
